newsitem.title: USA: Urban Shopping loses Cadillac Fairview contracts.
newsitem.headline: Urban Shopping loses Cadillac Fairview contracts.

text.p: Urban Shopping Centers Inc, a real estate investment trust, said Friday that effective November 1, 1996, nine property management contracts between its property management affiliate, Urban Retail Properties Co., and Cadillac Fairview U.S. will be canceled.
The nine properties total about 5.5 million square feet of retail space and accounted for about four percent of the management company's total revenue over the last 12 months.
Matthew Dominski, president and chief executive officer of Urban Shopping Centers, said in a statement, "It is the first significant loss of management business since our IPO in 1993."

He said the company is working on and hopes to announce shortly a number of new property management contracts. These contracts, if completed, together with a new contract to manage a mall in Indianapolis, are expected to offset to a large extent the impact of the loss of the Cadillac Fairview contracts, he said.
Urban Shopping Centers owns, manages, leases and develops properties and super-regional and regional malls.

Urban Retail Properties, a retail property manager, currently manages about 55 million square feet of regional malls, mixed-use properties and community centers in 27 states and the District of Columbia.
